findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: companies_universal_name_to_id, email_verify, g_institution_lookup · Private data: profile_full, profile_enrich, profile_employment_history, companies_universal_name_to_id, companies_enrich, companies_employees_data, search_people, email_prospects, search_alumni · Public sink: posts_info, posts_comments, posts_likes, email_verify, email_find, email_find_by_profile, email_reverse, email_prospects.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: companies_universal_name_to_id, email_verify, g_institution_lookup · Private data: profile_full, profile_enrich, profile_employment_history, companies_universal_name_to_id, companies_enrich, companies_employees_data, search_people, email_prospects, search_alumni · Public sink: posts_info, posts_comments, posts_likes, email_verify, email_find, email_find_by_profile, email_reverse, email_prospects

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
